scope: Equal-city and pool-weighted estimates for sampled local marker/way locations within the selected cities and historical sampling frame
warning: No national, length-weighted, graph, route, acoustic-function, campaign-yield, cross-country or ground-truth accuracy inference
source_quality_limitations: Source/viewer links do not prove the identity or capture date of the image actually inspected; source and capture metadata are observer supplied.

Year-only capture dates cannot locate an observation within the year. A year straddling the five-year cutoff is UNKNOWN; a current-year date retains the existing recent() rule but may postdate the reference date.
Incomplete, undated, invalid, stale, future, ambiguous-cutoff and unverifiable outcomes remain in the full sampled denominator.
Repeat agreement is descriptive within-observer consistency, not ground-truth accuracy; an incomplete repeat round is not full reliability.
Pool weights represent the sampled local marker/way frame, not street length, population, all national features or functional network truth.
quality_count_note: Capture-status counts are mutually exclusive; completion, year-only and source-reference counts overlap them.

missing_reason_definitions.incomplete: Completion flag is blank or false.
missing_reason_definitions.stale: Capture date precedes the five-year window.
missing_reason_definitions.future: Capture date (or year start) is after the reference date.
missing_reason_definitions.ambiguous_cutoff: Year-only capture interval straddles the five-year cutoff.
missing_reason_definitions.unverifiable: Observer explicitly could not verify the relevant outcome.
missing_reason_definitions.not_applicable: Attribute does not supply a verifiable binary outcome.

rates.denominator: all sampled arm locations; attribute rates are joint with crossing presence
rates.weight_note: Pool-weighted local marker/way-frame estimate; not length-weighted or national. Selected cities are fixed.

domains.road_class_note: Unweighted sample counts; road classes are not sampling strata.
